name: awf
description: Agentic workflow skills for one change from request to merge: specify the design, craft the plan, implement it, verify with evidence, request and resolve an independent code review, finalize the branch, and record session learnings.

interface.shortDescription: Spec, plan, implement, verify, review, and finalize a change
interface.longDescription: Turn a request into an approved spec and a task plan, execute it inline or through subagents, and verify every claim with fresh evidence bound to the exact tree. Request an independent read-only review, resolve its findings with evidence, finalize the branch safely, and record what the session taught.
defaultPrompt: Specify this feature before we write any code.
Review my changes since main against the spec.
Finalize this branch with a pull request.
